0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Mivli has a request which involves more than a little danger.

24.original: Survey the designated location and slay an overgrown megamaguey for its enlarged bulb.

25.original: Deliver the enlarged bulb to Mivli.

48.original: Say, you look like an intrepid individual. I could really use your help with something.

49.original: A short ways from here, in Chabameki, exceptionally large─shall we say, overgrown─megamaguey are known to appear.

50.original: I'd like you to take one down, and retrieve an enlarged bulb from its body. As for why, I'll tell you upon your return!

51.original: Go, my friend, and fell an overgrown megamaguey! I need an enlarged bulb from its body. I'll tell you why later!

52.original: Welcome back! How did you fare?

53.original: A perfect specimen! This will surely make for fine mezcal!

54.original: Tell me, were you aware that it was actually the peoples of Xak Tural who taught we Pelupelu how to make mezcal?

55.original: They taught us to make the liquor with agave, but we also learned that using the bulb of a megamaguey gives the drink a real kick.

56.original: And the megamaguey would give <hex:021A020203>me<hex:021A020103> a real kick if I tried to procure their bulbs myself.

57.original: Which is why I can't thank you enough for your help! I've no doubt the batch of mezcal I make with this will be a delight!
